findings.note: A's turn-3 precombat main, empty stack, A priority; eight untapped Mountains; Shivan Devastator, Abrade and Arc Lightning in hand. B controls Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Aegis Turtle (0/5).

Shivan Devastator ({X}{R}, 0/0 'Flying, haste. This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.') is cast with X=2, so the total cost is {2}{R}, paid by three Mountains. After two implied passes it enters with two +1/+1 counters as a 2/2. The entry replacement reads the spell's X.

Abrade ({1}{R}; 'Choose one — 3 damage to target creature; or destroy target artifact') is cast choosing mode 1 (1-based, the 3-damage mode) and targeting the Bears, paid by two Mountains. On resolution 3 damage is marked on the 2/2; state-based actions destroy it into B's graveyard before A receives priority. Abrade goes to A's graveyard.

Arc Lightning ({2}{R} sorcery, '3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets') is cast in the main phase with an empty stack. It targets the Turtle and B, divided 1 and 2 (each target gets at least 1; ruling 2014-09-20), paid by the last three Mountains. On resolution the Turtle has 1 damage marked and survives as a 0/5, and B loses 2 life (20 to 18). Arc goes to A's graveyard on top of Abrade, all eight Mountains are tapped, and A receives priority.
